about: Craft checklist, department sound (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/editing-style/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: a continuous room-tone bed per scene inside the band; no cut falls to digital silence
J- or L-cut at every scene boundary inside its durations
criteria.artefact: scene boundaries in the cut list

criteria.name: music and ambience leave the voice's presence band while the narrator speaks (measured gap)
criteria.artefact: music/bed stems vs the narration's word times
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §2 (PARTIAL): EBU Tech 3343 v4, dialogue vs programme loudness; the EQ numbers are NOT FOUND

criteria.name: every duck is a dip inside BP-53's band
a major impact is a three-layer composite hit on the frame
an acoustic vacuum before each of the largest reveals, then the hit
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): 0.8-1.2 s to -42 dBFS, three reveals (CRAFT_SOURCES §2)

criteria.name: at most two and a half sounds of one colour at once besides the voice (five when spread)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §2 (SUPPORTED): Murch, Dense Clarity - Clear Density (2.5 same colour, 5 spread)

criteria.name: narration centred, music wide, a spot effect on its source's screen side within the pan range
criteria.artefact: audio event pan + shot continuity card side
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §2 (SUPPORTED): Murch: dialogue centred, effects move with the action; the +-0.45 range is NOT FOUND

criteria.name: encoded and embodied sound are balanced: never two encoded streams (narration over a hero line) at once
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §2 (SUPPORTED): Murch: speech is encoded, music embodied

criteria.name: acoustic perspective follows the shot size; one impulse response per scene
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): the shelf, wet and dry numbers (CRAFT_SOURCES §2)

criteria.name: one motif per faction, hero and channel; it returns when its owner acts
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §3 (PARTIAL): The Playlist on the Nerdwriter LOTR essay: leitmotifs tied to people and places

criteria.name: with music up, an action cut falls on the beat grid
criteria.artefact: cut times vs the music's beat grid

criteria.name: music is spotted on scene or beat boundaries, with a planned no-music stretch
the delivered mix meets the loudness and true-peak gate
criteria.source: repo: BP-50 (binding; the -16 LUFS of the Blueprint is conflict 1 in CRAFT_CURRICULUM)
